title: From Tools to Missions: A Mission-Capability Runtime for Enterprise AI (R1.9: bounded closure with unresolved CREATE commit state)
description: Research whitepaper and reproducibility package for the Mission-Capability Runtime (MCR) and Minimum Capability Working Set (MCWS) program, release 1.9.0. Preserves the frozen MCWS benchmark result (Broad 5/48, Static 17/48, MCWS 30/48) and adds bounded runtime-control evidence (R1.7, R1.8, R1.9A synthetic foundation, R1.9B bounded live mutation attempt). In R1.9B, CREATE reached the ADT MCP provider, ACTIVATE did not, and the CREATE commit state remains UNKNOWN; the work does not claim end-to-end live mutation success. Documented evidence gaps are listed in the paper and release notes.
notes: Software components are Apache-2.0; documentation is CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE_POLICY.md in the repository).
